description.value:
Duration constant

A standing bonus against attempts to end your Rites or spellcasting.

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to saves against effects that would forcibly end your Rites, dispel your ongoing effects, or suppress your spellcasting.

cinderfall.incomplete: "+2 circumstance vs effects that would forcibly end your Rites, dispel your ongoing effects, or suppress your spellcasting" needs a counteract/dispel-resistance selector. Same confirmed absence as incontestable: no Suppress-style or counteract-named rule element exists anywhere in pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/, and real pf2e's counteract mechanic doesn't route through a save the target rolls in the first place.
